cases.why: First-line response then radiographic progression and switch.
cases.evidence: Metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma: first-line gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel with CA19-9 decline and smaller liver lesions after two cycles. Restaging after cycle 6 showed new peritoneal implants. Gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel discontinued for progression; started FOLFIRINOX as second-line.

cases.why: Initial SD on first-line then clear progression.
cases.evidence: Imatinib-sensitive GIST: first-line imatinib 400 mg daily. CT at month 3 showed stable disease. CT at month 11 documented new peritoneal nodules meeting progression. Imatinib stopped for progression; sunitinib planned.

cases.why: Initial response on first-line then progression and regimen change.
cases.evidence: Extensive-stage SCLC: first-line carboplatin/etoposide/atezolizumab with marked shrinkage of mediastinal nodes after cycle 2. After cycle 4, brain MRI showed new metastases. Platinum doublet held for progression; lurbinectedin discussed as second-line.

cases.why: Early imaging negative for progression; later positive.
cases.evidence: Metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer on first-line ADT plus docetaxel: bone scan after cycle 3 showed no new lesions. Scan after cycle 6 showed new rib metastases. Docetaxel discontinued for progression; abiraterone started.

cases.why: Possible progression later confirmed; first-line stopped for confirmed failure.
cases.evidence: Unresectable HCC on first-line atezolizumab/bevacizumab: week-8 note flagged a possible new satellite lesion. Confirmatory triphasic CT 12 days later showed unequivocal intrahepatic progression. Atezo/bev stopped for confirmed progression; lenvatinib planned.

cases.why: First-line pembrolizumab response then progression.
cases.evidence: Recurrent HNSCC: first-line pembrolizumab with partial response at week 9. At week 18, CT showed enlarging neck mass and new lung nodules. Pembrolizumab discontinued for progression; platinum/5-FU salvage started.

cases.why: Stable then progression on first-line carboplatin/paclitaxel.
cases.evidence: Advanced endometrial carcinoma on first-line carboplatin/paclitaxel: CT after cycle 3 stable. CT after cycle 6 showed new retroperitoneal nodes. Carboplatin/paclitaxel stopped for progression; pembrolizumab/lenvatinib planned.

cases.why: Biochemical/radiographic response then later failure.
cases.evidence: Pancreatic NET on first-line everolimus: chromogranin fell and liver lesions were smaller at month 4. At month 10, new bone lesions appeared. Everolimus discontinued for progression; lutetium DOTATATE considered second-line.

cases.why: Early marrow without progression; later clear failure.
cases.evidence: Waldenström macroglobulinemia on first-line bendamustine-rituximab: IgM falling after cycle 2 with no new adenopathy. After cycle 6, IgM rebound and new bulky nodes. BR stopped for progression; ibrutinib started as second-line.

cases.why: Marrow response then relapse on first-line.
cases.evidence: Ph-negative B-ALL: first-line hyper-CVAD with day-28 MRD-negative marrow. At month 5, circulating blasts returned. Hyper-CVAD discontinued for relapse; blinatumomab started as next line.

cases.why: Initial SD on gem/cis then progression.
cases.evidence: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma on first-line gemcitabine/cisplatin: MRI after cycle 3 stable. MRI after cycle 6 showed new satellite lesions. Gem/cis stopped for progression; FOLFOX second-line planned.

cases.why: Possible then confirmed progression; first-line TMZ stopped.
cases.evidence: GBM on first-line temozolomide after chemoradiation: month-2 MRI raised possible pseudoprogression versus true growth. Month-3 MRI confirmed increasing enhancing volume outside the RT field. TMZ stopped for confirmed progression; lomustine planned.

cases.why: Checkpoint response then later failure.
cases.evidence: Metastatic Merkel-cell carcinoma: first-line avelumab with near-complete cutaneous response at week 8. At week 20, new nodal basin involvement. Avelumab discontinued for progression; paclitaxel salvage started.

cases.why: Early markers/imaging negative; later progression.
cases.evidence: NSGCT on first-line BEP: tumor markers normalized after cycle 2 and CT showed no residual mass. After cycle 4, AFP rose and CT showed a new retroperitoneal node. BEP stopped for progression; TIP salvage planned.

cases.why: Stable pleural disease then progression on first-line.
cases.evidence: Pleural mesothelioma on first-line pemetrexed/cisplatin: CT after cycle 2 stable. CT after cycle 5 showed increasing pleural rind and new ascites. Pemetrexed/cisplatin discontinued for progression; nivolumab/ipilimumab discussed.

cases.why: TKI response then progression.
cases.evidence: Radioiodine-refractory DTC on first-line lenvatinib: thyroglobulin fell and lung nodules shrank at month 3. At month 9, new liver metastases. Lenvatinib stopped for progression; cabozantinib planned as second-line.

cases.why: Possible then confirmed PD; first-line stopped.
cases.evidence: Recurrent cervical cancer on first-line pembrolizumab/cisplatin/paclitaxel: cycle-3 note mentioned possible new pelvic thickening. Confirmatory MRI two weeks later showed clear progressive disease. First-line stopped for confirmed progression; tisotumab vedotin planned.

cases.why: Early CT without PD; later new metastases.
cases.evidence: HER2-negative esophageal adenocarcinoma on first-line FOLFOX plus nivolumab: CT after cycle 4 showed no progression. CT after cycle 8 showed new peritoneal deposits. FOLFOX/nivo discontinued for progression; paclitaxel/ramucirumab started.

cases.why: Neoadjuvant response then later failure of first-line MAP.
cases.evidence: Osteosarcoma: first-line MAP with >90% necrosis at resection. During adjuvant MAP, restaging showed new pulmonary nodules. MAP discontinued for progression; ifosfamide/etoposide second-line started.

cases.why: Stable then progression on first-line CAP.
cases.evidence: Unresectable thymoma on first-line cyclophosphamide/doxorubicin/cisplatin: CT after cycle 2 stable. CT after cycle 6 showed increasing mediastinal bulk. CAP stopped for progression; octreotide plus everolimus discussed.

cases.why: Spleen/symptom response then progression on first-line ruxolitinib.
cases.evidence: Intermediate-risk myelofibrosis: first-line ruxolitinib with spleen reduction and better scores at month 3. At month 10, spleen re-enlarged with rising blasts. Ruxolitinib discontinued for progression; fedratinib started.

cases.why: Early imaging without PD; later inguinal progression.
cases.evidence: Penile squamous carcinoma on first-line paclitaxel/ifosfamide/cisplatin: CT after cycle 2 showed no new nodes. CT after cycle 4 showed enlarging inguinal adenopathy. TIP stopped for progression; pembrolizumab considered next.

cases.why: Possible then confirmed PD on first-line cisplatin.
cases.evidence: Advanced vulvar cancer on first-line cisplatin: week-5 exam noted a possible new satellite plaque. Punch biopsy and photo documentation one week later confirmed progressive cutaneous disease. Cisplatin stopped for confirmed progression; paclitaxel planned.

cases.why: Skin response then later systemic failure of first-line.
cases.evidence: Advanced mycosis fungoides: first-line brentuximab vedotin with clearing of plaques at cycle 3. At cycle 8, new visceral lesions on PET. Brentuximab stopped for progression; gemcitabine-based second-line started.

cases.why: Same workup denies vs documents completed first-line.
cases.evidence: Pancreatic-cancer intake: patient reports never receiving systemic chemotherapy. Same-day oncology addendum: completed six cycles of first-line gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel with subsequent progression; proceed to second-line consult.

cases.why: Denies prior systemic therapy vs documents completed first-line platinum.
cases.evidence: SCLC second-opinion (4 Mar 2025): patient states no prior systemic therapy. Outside records same day: completed four cycles of first-line carboplatin/etoposide with subsequent progression on CT.

cases.why: Never treated vs documented completed first-line imatinib.
cases.evidence: GIST clinic: intake form says never treated with a TKI. Pharmacy reconciliation the same visit lists completed 12 months of first-line imatinib with later radiographic progression.

cases.why: Never received induction vs documented completed first-line hyper-CVAD.
cases.evidence: ALL transplant evaluation: patient reports never receiving induction chemotherapy. Leukemia note same week: completed first-line hyper-CVAD with subsequent marrow relapse.

cases.why: Ongoing first-line with response; no failure event.
cases.evidence: GIST: currently on first-line imatinib month 4. Last CT showed ongoing response. Plan to continue imatinib; no progression documented.

cases.why: Ongoing first-line with continued response.
cases.evidence: Pancreatic NET: currently receiving first-line everolimus month 2. Chromogranin falling; no new lesions. Plan to continue; no progression documented.
